channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Amazon lays off 250 employees via early morning emails, less than a month after 1,000 job cuts: Who was hit?
item.description: Amazon has laid off around 250 employees in its devices and services division, with workers informed through early morning emails and text messages.

item.title: Iran war drives up fuel costs: US cruise ship MV Odyssey runs out of money, suspends voyage; 200 left stranded
item.description: The ship has been carrying 203 passengers, mostly Americans, along with 156 crew members, according to Cambodian officials. It has a 650-passenger capacity.

item.title: Microsoft buyout: Why CFO expects ‘very few’ of 60,000 to accept Voluntary Exit Offer
item.description: Microsoft’s finance chief has told staff she expects ‘very few people’ to take up a voluntary exit offer extended to roughly 60,000 workers, pointing to growth opportunities at the company as the reason most are likely to stay.

item.title: AI chip shortage could worsen in 2027: What Samsung’s record $80 billion quarterly profit tells us
item.description: Samsung Electronics reported record third-quarter operating profit of 107.44 trillion won, up 783% year over year, as AI demand boosted chip earnings.

item.title: Mint Explainer | Anthropic IPO proves profitable gen-AI is hard. India on the same boat too?
item.description: Most generative AI companies incur incredibly high operating costs for servers in data centres, while adoption of their products remains either heavily subsidised or in its early stages.

item.title: Lab Rats series: Unlocking the kidney for therapy with Helex
item.description: Hyderabad-based Helex Inc is working on a first-in-class mechanism to deliver gene editing drugs safely into the kidneys—a massive medical challenge currently. They not only want to do it first, but also develop it to be affordable for most Indians.&nbsp;

item.title: Apple Unveils Touch-Screen MacBook Pro, Reversing Long-Held Jobs Stance
item.description: After two decades of spurning the idea, Apple Inc. unveiled an overhauled MacBook Pro that includes a touch screen, giving its flagship laptop a feature that has become a must-have in the personal computer industry.

item.title: Exclusive-US DOJ is inquiring about Nvidias purchase of Hugging Face, sources say
item.description: NVIDIA-DOJ-HUGGING-FACE:Exclusive-US DOJ is inquiring about Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face, sources say

item.title: Inside IPO-bound Anthropic: How much code does Claude write for firm? What is its 'no-ego' work culture about? Explained
item.description: Anthropic’s IPO filing says its co-founders hold 50.1% of the voting power on certain matters, and the company could reach a $1.5 trillion valuation. The filing also reports how much Claude contributed to Anthropic’s codebase in September.

item.title: Adani eyes €3 billion acquisition of Dutch energy storage firm VTTI as supply disruptions boost demand
item.description: Billionaire Gautam Adani, India’s richest person, is exploring a potential acquisition of Dutch energy storage group VTTI as supply disruptions make the facilities more valuable for energy trading, people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: Chennai Metro Phase II: How Hitachi Rail's ₹1,620 crore contract will power driverless trains
item.description: Hitachi Rail's CBTC system automatically manages train movement, including acceleration and braking. It also calculates suitable operating speeds in real time, allowing trains to run at intervals of up to 90 seconds.

item.title: Pee Safe enters nutraceuticals with Within, targets ₹100 crore revenue in 3 years - Biz roadmap | Exclusive Interview
item.description: The company expands beyond hygiene and personal care to build a wider women's health and wellness brand. Talking to Livemint, co-founder Rithish Kumar opened up about the new launch, Within.

item.title: Adani Airport, foreign airlines deadlocked over Mumbai airport shift
item.description: Carriers want until October 2027 to move some international operations to Navi Mumbai, but Adani Airport plans to begin cutting capacity at the existing airport in April.

item.title: LOHUM ropes in 2010 Nobel laureate to lead materials science research
item.description: Konstantin Novoselov will helm LOHUM’s new technology incubator.

item.title: Meesho flags higher festive and tech costs in Q2 as margins improve
item.description: Contribution margin improved to 6% of NMV in Q2, but the e-commerce platform expects elevated customer acquisition and server costs to temper near-term gains.

item.title: Who is Rajesh Ambati? Meet the Indian-origin Apple engineer promoted to VP of engineering: His role and career journey
item.description: Indian-origin engineer Rajesh Ambati has been promoted to vice-president of engineering at Apple after nearly 18 years at the company. He oversees connectivity, cellular and satellite software as Apple reshapes its leadership under CEO John Ternus.

item.title: Billable hours are giving way to value-based pricing: Eisner’s Charles Weinstein
item.description: In an interview, the CEO of Eisner Advisory Group discusses the imminent collapse of traditional hourly rates, the firm’s deployment of 11 homegrown AI audit tools, and how mid-tier firms can compete with Big Four GCCs.

item.title: From President Murmu’s ADC to streetwear: Major Rishabh Sambyal teams up with Bonkers Corner
item.description: Retired Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal, former Aide-de-Camp to President Droupadi Murmu, has collaborated with streetwear label Bonkers Corner on a clothing collection featuring hoodies, a jacket and shirts.

item.title: Adani Enterprises revenue jumps 75% as new businesses ramp up; Adani Ports raises FY27 guidance
item.description: Copper smelting and Navi Mumbai airport boosted Adani Enterprises’ revenue, while Adani Ports lifts its growth outlook and is planning higher capital spending.

item.title: Info Edge CEO Hitesh Oberoi to step down after 27 years
item.description: Founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani's appointment and redesignation as executive vice chairman, managing director, and group CEO have been approved by the board, effective 3 December 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

item.title: Tata Sons feud draws Rahul Gandhi, Nirmala Sitharaman into public spat
item.description: The exchange marks a rare public intervention by senior political leaders in the leadership dispute at Tata Sons involving Chairman N. Chandrasekaran and Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata.

item.title: Bandhan Bank sees ₹200 crore hit to third-party income from Irdai’s proposed distribution overhaul
item.description: The lender expects to recoup most of the potential loss by expanding insurance sales in smaller towns and pushing mutual fund distribution.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's founders explore deal to separate ice cream brand from Magnum: What is the plan and why?
item.description: Ben &amp; Jerry's co-founders Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield are exploring a deal to separate the ice cream brand from owner Magnum and place it under an employee stock-ownership plan. Magnum has rejected a sale, citing costs and risks to the brand's social mission.

item.title: No calls from HR, no access to devices: AI company Innodata lays off nearly 550 Indians post lunch break
item.description: According to multiple posts on X, Innodata India Pvt Ltd has fired almost 550 employees in India. This comes after reportedly firing workers in the Philippines over a Zoom call.

item.title: Scale wards off volatility, keeps us steady: L&T's Shankar Raman
item.description: “Unless we do something dramatically well or dramatically stupid, I don’t think there will be a huge volatility in our outcomes”, L&amp;T's Shankar Raman said.

item.title: Mukesh Ambani’s telecom journey: from losing Reliance Infocomm to listing Jio Platforms
item.description: The Jio Platforms listing caps Mukesh Ambani’s quarter-century telecom quest, which survived a family split, regulatory battles and years of investment before revenue. His journey has come almost full circle.

item.title: TVS family feud: Venu Srinivasan’s wife, daughter seek amicable resolution to business ownership dispute
item.description: Mallika Srinivasan and daughter Lakshmi Venu say they remain willing to resolve the TVS family’s business dispute through transparent dialogue. Details here.

item.title: Jio nears global telecom top five by market cap; monetization in focus
item.description: Jio’s $137 billion valuation approaches those of global telecom giants despite a far smaller revenue base, putting the spotlight on earnings growth and returns on capital.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi says Tata being ‘criminally destroyed’; Nirmala Sitharaman hits back, says ‘refrain from seeing ghosts’
item.description: Rahul Gandhi's remarks come amid a dispute over Tata Sons' leadership after Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata challenged the validity of the September 17 board resolution to reappoint N Chandrasekaran as chairman of the holding company of the Tata Group.

item.title: Hyundai’s Q2 revenue hits record, but rising costs squeeze profits for third straight quarter
item.description: Hyundai Motor India’s margins remain under pressure from commodity inflation, leaving price hikes, easing input costs and new-model sales to drive a second-half recovery.

item.title: Star Health wants mandated products kept out of Irdai’s expense cap
item.description: Star Health has broadly welcomed Irdai's proposed distribution reforms but wants products mandated by regulation kept out of the formula used to calculate expense caps.&nbsp;

item.title: Fibe bets on AI as profit doubles ahead of ₹1000+ crore IPO
item.description: Fibe is making artificial intelligence central to its lending model as it prepares for a proposed IPO that could exceed ₹1,000 crore. Its system evaluates more than 27,000 variables, with automated decisions covering 95% of loans.&nbsp;

item.title: Gera Developments introduces The Gera Advantage to support customers across their homeownership journey
item.description: Gera Developments has launched The Gera Advantage, a customer-support programme offering eligible homebuyers financial assistance before receiving an occupancy certificate and preventive maintenance checks for seven years afterwards.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Sanjeev Bikhchandani? Meet the entrepreneur taking charge of Info Edge after 27 years
item.description: Info Edge co-founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani will take over as executive vice chairman, managing director and group CEO from December 3, 2026, following Hitesh Oberoi’s decision to step down from his full-time operating role after nearly 27 years at the company.

item.title: From AI to cloud and connectivity from space: Akash Ambani announces Jio's plans to expand beyond affordable data
item.description: Akash Ambani, Managing Director of Jio Platforms Limited, said on Wednesday that the next phase would go beyond affordable data to artificial intelligence, cloud computing, connected devices, satellite connectivity and digital services yet to be imagined.
